text:
nancy: quick heads-up — we're seeing a regression signal in the pre-release int6 build for qx6b on de-id prompts. i'm spinning a short curation pass to triage before we open a canary.

omar: thanks. what's the sample size? and do we have a golden set baseline to compare?

nancy: pulling 1k samples stratified by entity-density (low/med/high). will include ~120 prompts with pii masks and 80 RAG-style retrieval prefixes. will compare to q6b-hosted and qx6b-int4.

jen: label_ops — can we get an expedited micro-golden for 150 items? prioritize high-entity-density and any multi-turn where deid spans >2 turns. tag: golden_set_urgent.

label_ops: can do. with 3 labelers and current workflow we'll finish 150 micro-golden in ~4 hrs. we'll surface ambiguous cases in a review doc.

harry: add tokenizer-check step. int6 build showed different split for emoji+ZWJ sequences in earlier run. that can easily flip entity boundaries. example check below:
```
# tokenizer diff check
python tools/token_diff.py --input sample.json --model qx6b-int6 --baseline q6b-hosted --out diffs.csv
```

nancy: good call. also include a kvcache-consistency script — we've had hallucinated insertions when cache gets misaligned on repeated generate calls.

omar: for de-dupe, i've been using normalized canonicalization then shingled similarity. threshold 0.8 worked well last month. command:
```
./bin/normalize_and_shingle --input /tmp/int6-sample.json --out /tmp/int6-dedup.json --threshold 0.8
```

jen: workflow reminder: after dedupe -> seed label queue -> run auto-evals (entity-F1, hallucination-rate, perplexity delta) -> manual side-by-side diff against qx6b-int4. please keep the sample IDs stable so we can trace back.

label_ops: starting the priority queue now. marking 20 items as spot-check for the triage meeting. will also add comment flags when annotator confidence < 0.7.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: canary/qx6b-int6-deid #45 by nancy. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/45 :robot_face:

harry: small nit — make sure rollout config disables auto-variant-mapping. we want manual flip if metrics look good. saved us from surprise alias swaps before.

omar: collecting metrics sheet template. columns: id, prompt_tokens, baseline_entity_f1, int4_entity_f1, int6_entity_f1, hall_rate_delta, tokenizer_diff_flag, label_confidence, action (pass/warn/block). will push a CSV to /reports/qx6b-int6-deid/metrics.csv

nancy: plan: push deduped sample to /datasets/curation/qx6b-int6-deid/dedup.json by EOD, seed label queue, run token_diff and auto-eval overnight, and bring a triage deck to tomorrow's sync. if entity_f1 drops > 4% on high-entity set, we pause canary.

jen: also add a small adversarial probe: prefix the prompt with truncated context to force boundary errors, and with noisy unicode to stress tokenizer. add as separate column in metrics: adversarial_tag.

label_ops: note — some annotators already reported increased ambiguous redaction cases with emojis. capturing examples in /annotations/qx6b-int6-deid/ambiguous.md

harry: once we have first 50 golden annotated, let's do a quick 20-min triage to decide whether to continue. can someone drop the meeting invite?

omar: dropping invite now. 30m after first 50 complete.

nancy: thanks all — will update thread with sample link and initial diffs. :eyes:
